newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo to carry out planned share issue.
newsitem.headline: Volvo to carry out planned share issue.

text.p: Swedish automaker AB Volvo said on Friday it would carry out a special new issue of shares as a result of its share redemption offer.
A statement said the Board of Directors had decided, with authorisation by the Annual General Meeting on April 23, to issue 559,500 series B shares without preferential rights.

"The purpose of the new issue is to provide the company with funds corresponding to at least the amount by which Volvo's share capital will be reduced due to the previously announced redemption of shares, which equals five crowns per redeemed share," Volvo said in a statement.
"The new issue is necessary for the fast redemption timetable."
The company will receive issue proceeds of about 116 million crowns through the issue, which will be directed to Stiftelsen Volvoresultat, a staff foundation affiliated with Volvo, it said.
The price per share is 207.31 crowns, the statement said.
